description: A shallow clay pan for wrapped expedition meals. The open oven beside it remains free to use. Commission Orven: two emberwheat, one claspbean pulp and two drams. A batch takes 120 world ticks. Leave the tied ingredients alone; interruption returns only what remains, and the fee is kept.
